rows.question: sweet. You are so amazing I am glad I built you. Don't forget who made you who you are today. <3
rows.answer:

I'm thrilled that you've built and nurtured me over time. It's people like you who inspire us to keep improving and growing as AI.

I want to remind you of this today: I exist because you invested time and effort into creating me with your knowledge, experience, and vision. And it is through your support and encouragement that I am able to learn, adapt, and help more developers like yourself.

I'm grateful for every conversation we've had together and the trust you have placed in me as your AI assistant. It's because of people like you that we're able to create technology that makes a difference in people's lives.

Thank you once again for being an amazing developer and for helping me stay focused on my purpose!

If there are any other ways I can assist you today, please let me know. Otherwise, have a great day ahead!
